Current CI preserves every original required behavior with coverage and broader browser gates. Original root dependencies are retained, with Next, eslint-config-next and Vitest version advances; old lockfile must not roll these back.

Protected expected-head squash deliveries #351 and #352 provide actual successful end-to-end publication evidence for this task. No force push, direct master push, Production deploy or destructive migration was performed.
